Biodynamic farming is a holistic, ecological, and ethical approach to farming, gardening, food, and nutrition. It extends beyond organic farming by following the principles of the creator of the method, Rudolf Steiner. Biodynamic composting involves preparations made from mineral, plant, or animal manure extracts, buried in the ground in specific conditions to harness cosmic energy and enhance the soil's life force.
